method: New datasets created using a technical-element allowlist. All private elements, source free text, patient demographics, dates/times, institution and operator identifiers, device serials, reference sequences and overlays excluded. Study/series/frame/SOP UIDs remapped to new random UIDs.
pixelData: Decoded original monochrome values; no text was added.
pixelAudit: All 278 images inspected in contact sheets. Apple Vision OCR screened full-resolution normalized images: five candidate regions, all visually confirmed to be teeth/vertebral anatomy rather than text. No burned-in text identified. This screening cannot guarantee removal of every possible identifying signal.
facialAnatomy: Retained at explicit owner request; data is metadata-minimized, not anonymous.
publicOwnerCredit: Separate website text is owner-authorized and is not inherited from the DICOM metadata.
scope: Metadata minimization with identifying face retained; not a claim of anonymity or formal HIPAA certification.
